Cloudflare Introduces Full Transaction Detection for WAF

2026-10-27 · AI-assisted, source-attributed report

According to Cloudflare, their web application firewall (WAF) can now correlate an HTTP request with its corresponding response. This new capability is known as full transaction detection.

Cloudflare states that full transaction detection helps every customer find successful exploits, data exposure, and risky misconfigurations. The official source notes that these are issues that request-only inspection can miss.

Original source: Introducing full transaction detection for Cloudflare WAF

This article summarizes a publisher announcement. It has not been independently fact-checked.
